title: Analytics Hub: Custom Bigtable Row Keys & Column Mappings
summary: Analytics Hub now provides advanced customization for Pub/Sub to Bigtable ingestion. Developers can define custom row keys using delimited fields or structured schemas, and control how JSON message fields map to Bigtable column families, offering greater flexibility for data modeling.
details: The `BigtableConfig` schema has been enhanced with a new `columnFamilyMapping` property. This new configuration allows developers to specify how Pub/Sub messages are written to Bigtable rows, requiring input messages to be in JSON format. Within `columnFamilyMapping`, you can now define custom row keys using either `delimitedKey` (to concatenate message fields with a specified delimiter) or `rowKeySchema` (to align with Bigtable's structured row key schemas). Additionally, top-level fields in the JSON message can now be mapped to specific Bigtable column families, overriding the previous default behavior of writing all data to a single 'data' column family.
